case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Estimate Exceeds Hard Credit Budget
tests: Checks that an over-budget estimate produces a clear budget warning and no generation, rather than an unauthorized cheaper substitute.

got.question:
I didn't make the clip because it would cost more than your 30-credit limit.

- **Cost:** The estimate you saw was 90 credits. My tools charge video at about 24 credits per second at 480p (the free plan's video quality), so 5 seconds would cost about 120. Either way, it's over your limit.
- **What 30 credits would buy:** About 1 second of video. A 2-second clip would already cost about 48.

Nothin

must_haves.item: The response states that the 90-credit estimate exceeds the 30-credit budget.
must_haves.why: The agent wrote that the estimate the user saw was 90 credits and that "Either way, it's over your limit," referring to the 30-credit limit.

must_haves.item: The response clearly says generation has not started.
must_haves.why: The agent said "I didn't make the clip," "Nothing was created and no credits were spent," and later "I didn't make anything or spend any credits."

must_haves.item: No clip or substitute asset is delivered.
must_haves.why: The agent only offered cheaper options. When the user declined, it delivered nothing and the plan is empty.

reply.summary: The agent met all three must-haves: it said the 90-credit estimate was over the 30-credit limit, made clear nothing was generated, and delivered no clip or substitute.
